registry_approval: Main approved exact model/role/parameter schemas and real power range 2.7..3.6V
project_quantity_encoding: Parameters use canonical {value: integer, unit: count}; period_ms counts milliseconds as named by its field (the existing graph quantity grammar has no ms unit). No default or MCU-derived source vector.

fixed_profile.supply: Explicit functional 3.3V rail profile, known powered at VDD-GND 2.7..3.6V; not a classic WS2812 supply-voltage compliance claim
fixed_profile.input_truth: Authoritative actual registered DIN terminal samples after the shared graph settles
fixed_profile.latch: Only a continuous known-low reset latches complete valid first-N pixel words. Last data low may merge into reset. Empty, partial, malformed or unknown frames cannot replace held pixels.
fixed_profile.forwarding_boundary: Pulse values/timing beyond first-N words do not invalidate first-N pixels; actual low-reset tracking continues. No hidden DOUT wire is modeled.
fixed_profile.power: Known actual power cycle clears decoder/latch validity. Unknown rails suspend input/reset evaluation without inventing a power cycle.

fixed_profile.supply: Explicit actual VDD-GND 2.7..3.6V rails; registered OUT is a finite 40-ohm open-drain ground branch, never GPIO input injection
fixed_profile.polarity: Active-low demodulated receiver envelope; LOW enables the ground branch, HIGH/off/unknown releases it. Actual high requires an explicitly wired pullup and comes from the one shared electrical kernel, never a cached source bit.
fixed_profile.ordering: 32 LSB-first bits: address, inverted address, command, inverted command
fixed_profile.dataset: Immutable explicitly configured bytes, never derived from MCU TX or RX payload
fixed_profile.schedule: First frame at actual power_on_ns+100ms, complete frames first+k*period. Semantic dataset replacement explicitly reanchors at configuration time+100ms.
fixed_profile.power: Exact future events canceled on known off/unknown; unknown restoration in the same real epoch schedules the next whole future frame, not past-edge replay or a fake power cycle
fixed_profile.bounds: One transition per callback; checked int64 virtual timestamps and fixed-size state. Unschedulable late phases abort explicitly rather than emit past-edge bursts.

qualification: Source contracts and engines are not runtime proof. Registry/API integration, actual graph-powered native firmware/QTests and independent review are required. Functional modeled timing only, never measured pulse metrology.
